title: Qualify cross-family scientific numerical boundaries and close original C03
commitMessage: feat: qualify cross-family scientific boundaries and close M6 W02 C03

contribution.summary: Qualify the final original C03 T2 cross-family risk gate with explicit unit, discrete-sampling and linear-topology policies. Recover one compiled missing-API RED and pass 78 GREEN, 758 retained scientific tests, four Math regressions and six SHA-identical isolated preview.12 NuGet consumers. Close C03-T2 R/G/V, T2 and parent C03 only. Keep M6-W02/M6 in-progress and C04/C05 planned, without public package or error theorem.
contribution.value: Compose seven previously qualified S01/S02/S03 conservative audits into one typed all-or-nothing boundary result with a precise family refusal reason, pre-cancellation and no exposed partial numeric result. Caller-owned frames, units, sampling and linear topology are explicit acknowledgements, not automatic validation of physical compatibility.
debtChanges: Observe one independently compiled missing cross-family boundary API RED before staging source; no compiler-error substitution.
Recover RED with 78 independent GREEN checks for canonical seven-family oracles, explicit caller policies, cancellation and typed reason precedence.
Accept caller-managed independent Cartesian, signal and time/value units explicitly, without asserting unit compatibility or implicit conversion.
Use existing S01 geometry distance/projection and S02 direct DFT/convolution conservative audits, including refused zero/cancelling risk cases.
Use existing S03 uniform time-grid, relative difference and signed mean cancellation audits with explicitly supplied sampleTimes.
Never leak any prior numeric family result if a later family refuses; preserve one typed per-family refusal reason and cancel first.
Retain 57 parent C03-T1, 107 S03-T2, 61 S03-T1, 69 S02-T2, 60 S02-T1, 53 S01-T2, 25 S01-T1 and 326 C01/C02 tests plus four Math regressions.
Pack and inspect one actual scientific preview.12 net10 NuGet archive, nuspec identity, zero foreign dependencies, byte length and SHA-256.
Run six independently restored source-free eight-probe clients from a single cleared local feed, each pinned to preview.12 with identical inspected SHA.
Close only original C03-T2-R/G/V, T2 and parent C03; M6-W02 and M6 stay in-progress, C04/C05 remain planned.
contribution.nextAction: After durable RS100 success, prepare RS101 on M6-W02-C04-T1: bounded pure financial math with explicit rate/discount conventions and independent 100/1.1 = 1000/11 and [-100,110] IRR = 10% oracles. Avoid market data or financial recommendations. Keep C04-T2, C05, M6-W02 and M6 open.

achievements.achievement: Observe one independently compiled missing-public cross-family boundary API RED before sidecar implementation is staged.
Recover RED and pass 78 independent seven-family numerical, explicit-policy, typed-refusal and no-partial-data GREEN tests.
Preserve 758 scientific tests and four Math regressions; SHA-verify one actual preview.12 archive through six isolated eight-probe NuGet clients.
Qualify original C03-T2 conservative cross-family integration over seven S01/S02/S03 audits with explicit caller responsibilities.
Close original size-L C03 only after independently qualified S01/S02/S03, original T1 and original T2 have durable evidence; leave C04/C05/W02/M6 open.
